acceptance.given: A Replay Result has reached the successful-result evaluation phase and contains the bound Probe execution record.

oracle.expected: The replay verifier emits an independent Probe verification outcome bound to that successful Replay Result.
forbidden: A successful Replay Result lacks an independent Probe verification.
Probe success is accepted solely from the replay result without an independent verification outcome.
oracle.observable: The replay-verification result produced by the semantic runtime records the independently evaluated Probe outcome.

acceptance.then: The successful Replay Result exposes a separately evaluated Probe verification outcome.
acceptance.when: The semantic replay verifier evaluates the successful Replay Result.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the replay semantic verifier against a successful Replay Result whose Probe verification record is absent or not independently derived; observe the required failing runtime verdict.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Add or correct Toolchain replay verification so a successful Replay Result requires a distinct, independently evaluated Probe verification outcome.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Remove the independent-Probe verification requirement without changing persisted replay-result schemas or historical evidence.

slice_hint.state_transition: successful Replay Result with no independent Probe verification established -> successful Replay Result with an independent Probe verification outcome established
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The semantic replay verification of every successful Replay Result requires and exposes an independently derived Probe verification outcome.

acceptance.given: A target package is being inspected or resolved and its identity has not yet been independently verified.

oracle.expected: A Toolchain verification result independently records the resolved target package identity.
forbidden: Treating package identity as verified without an independent verification.
Accepting a missing, illegal, unsupported, escaping, substituted, or wrong target identity.
oracle.observable: The target-package validation result emitted during Toolchain inspection contains the independently verified identity.

acceptance.then: The target package identity is independently verified before inspection proceeds.
acceptance.when: The Toolchain package validator resolves the target package.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Exercise target resolution with an identity that is missing, substituted, or cannot be independently verified; observe fail-closed validation.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Make Toolchain target resolution emit and require an independently verified target package identity before effective inspection.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Revert identity-verification logic while retaining existing package capability configuration and without modifying historical artifacts.

slice_hint.state_transition: target package identity not independently verified -> target package identity independently verified
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: A target cannot enter effective inspection unless Toolchain validation has produced its independent identity verification outcome.

acceptance.given: A detached negative Probe execution has been requested with its declared input payload.

oracle.expected: The detached negative Probe receives execution-bound inputs and its produced outputs are bound to and observable from the execution result.
forbidden: The negative Probe runs with unbound inputs.
The negative Probe produces outputs that are not bound to the execution result.
oracle.observable: The detached-Probe execution record associates the negative Probe input binding and output binding with the same execution identity.

acceptance.then: The detached negative Probe execution has bound, observable inputs and outputs.
acceptance.when: The Toolchain process executor launches and collects the detached negative Probe.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the detached negative Probe selector with an omitted or mismatched input/output execution binding and observe the binding validator fail.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Bind declared negative-Probe inputs and collected outputs to one detached execution record and reject missing or mismatched bindings.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Revert detached-Probe binding enforcement without changing persisted evidence or replay-result schemas.

slice_hint.state_transition: detached negative Probe without established bound input/output record -> detached negative Probe with input and output bound to the same execution
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Detached negative Probe completion is rejected unless its declared inputs and produced outputs are both bound and observable on the same execution record.

acceptance.given: Frozen historical artifacts with an established membership exist before repair or runtime operations.

oracle.expected: The pre-operation and post-operation frozen-artifact membership inventories are identical.
forbidden: Historical artifact membership is added, removed, or reordered.
A repair or runtime operation treats rewritten historical membership as appended evidence.
oracle.observable: A deterministic before/after membership comparison performed at the repair or runtime boundary reports identical ordered frozen membership.

acceptance.then: Frozen historical artifact membership remains unchanged after the operation.
acceptance.when: The Toolchain repair or runtime boundary evaluates the pre-operation and post-operation frozen-artifact inventories.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Compare a baseline frozen-membership inventory with a candidate inventory containing an addition, removal, or reordering; observe the integrity check fail.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce a Toolchain before/after frozen-artifact membership comparison at repair and runtime boundaries, permitting only evidence append operations under declared boundaries.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Revert membership-comparison enforcement only; frozen historical artifacts, their membership, paths, and bytes remain untouched.

slice_hint.state_transition: established frozen historical membership before operation -> identical frozen historical membership after repair or runtime operation
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The boundary integrity check fails for any added, removed, or reordered frozen historical member and accepts only an identical before/after membership inventory.
